mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM user WHERE created_at >= #{startDateTime} AND created_at < #{endDateTime} AND role = 'USER' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY signup_date ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS request_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED') THEN 1 END) AS success_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS failure_count FROM ai_consultation_event WHERE occurred_at >= #{startDateTime} AND occurred_at < #{endDateTime}

SELECT kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, version_code, data_date FROM kb_product_data_version WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY data_date DESC, completed_at DESC, kb_product_data_version_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN 1 END) AS deposit_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN 1 END) AS savings_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'ETF' THEN 1 END) AS etf_count FROM kb_product_version pv JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id WHERE pv.kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 422 THEN 1 END) AS http_422_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 500 THEN 1 END) AS http_500_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN result = 'TIMEOUT' THEN 1 END) AS timeout_count FROM admin_access_log WHERE occurred_at >= #{startDateTime} AND occurred_at < #{endDateTime} AND request_uri LIKE '/api/%' AND request_uri != '/api/admin' AND request_uri NOT LIKE '/api/admin/%' AND request_uri != '/api/health' AND request_uri NOT LIKE '/api/health/%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_access_log ( http_method, request_uri, response_status, result, elapsed_ms, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{httpMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{responseStatus}, #{result}, #{elapsedMs}, #{occurredAt} )
